tool_args.rationale: The pilot horizons are at most 0.48, far shorter than the target H of 20. The slow-horizon probe directly tests the predicted adaptation and identifies its timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow adaptation timescale or its long-horizon effect.
More fine short-window observations would be less direct for resolving the long-horizon ambiguity.
The short pilot cannot distinguish these mechanisms from sink-coupled adaptation at the target horizon.
